Note: 1. Reservation will be as per UP Government Norms (Vertical & Horizontal).
2. UR: Unreserved, EWS: Economical Weaker Section, SC: Schedule Caste, ST: Schedule Tribe, OBC: Other
Backward Classes.
3. The number of posts advertised is indicative and the University reserves the right not to fill up any post, decrease
or increase the number of posts.
4. Eligible persons may submit their applications through online mode only by visiting HBTU, Kanpur website
http:/www.hbtu.ac.in. The details of the procedure for online submission of applications, General Instruction &
Information, Recruitment Rules, Screening and Shortlisting criteria, tentative schedule of Recruitment Process
etc. are available on the University website.
5. The last date for submitting the complete application with all documents in online mode is 08-12-2026 (Tuesday)
till 11:59 pm. The candidates need to upload all relevant documents with the application form only.
6. Any correspondence in regard of this recruitment should be addressed to the Email ID:
recruitment2026@hbtu.ac.in only.
(Registrar)
